info.name: Arcadia API Reference Auth Utility Meters (Beta) API

params.name: client_user_id
params.description: A client_user_id to filter the list of returned items by.

params.name: utility_account_id
params.description: A utility account id to filter the list of returned items by.

params.name: service_types
params.description: A list of service types to filter the list of returns items by.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: ISO8601 datetime, used to traverse paginated responses. Use of this parameter is mutually exclusive with `updated_before`.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: ISO8601 datetime, used to traverse paginated responses. Use of this parameter is mutually exclusive with `updated_after`.

params.name: order
params.description: Used to specify the order in which records should be returned. Currently ordered by `updated_at` timestamp.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of utility meters for all users, utility accounts, and service types. May be filtered by `client_user_id`, `utility_account_id`, and/or `service_types` to further refine results. Default ordered by descending `updated_at`.
Returns a single utility meter specified by ID.
